# TaxID integration reference

TaxID embeds fiscal operations in partners’ existing invoicing, accounting,
POS and ERP software. Current invited access is a simulator. Production access
requires merchant authorization, real KRA evidence and applicable approval.

## Contracts

- Keep branch API keys server-side. Invitation links open the workspace; they
  are not application credentials.
- Submit POST /v2/etims/sale. Retain clientReference, idempotency key and exact
  request body. Retrieve GET /v2/etims/sales/search?clientReference=<encoded>.
- SIGNED means a persisted control-unit receipt, not central KRA acceptance.
  SIMULATED output makes no KRA submission.
- OUTCOME_UNKNOWN and RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED require investigation of the
  original transaction, not automatic resubmission or a replacement reference.
- Raw resultCd values differ from TaxID HTTP errors and transaction statuses.
  Duplicate codes do not recover receipt signatures or prove identical contents.
- VSCU signing uses /trnsSales/saveSales. Do not invent a second saveInvoice call.
- Initialization 902 does not recover cmcKey. Retain the original key securely;
  missing device credentials require operator recovery.
- Rates and classifications require current reference data and merchant mapping.
  Historical sample rates are not current tax advice.

## Sources

Official: cited KRA v2.0 response-code tables.
Observed: retained, version-specific TaxID sandbox evidence.
Reported: external reports requiring independent verification.

Reference: https://docs.taxid.co.ke/
Machine-readable codes: https://docs.taxid.co.ke/errors.json
VSCU specification: https://www.kra.go.ke/images/publications/VSCU_Specification_Document_v2.0.pdf
OSCU specification: https://www.kra.go.ke/images/publications/OSCU_Specification_Document_v2.0.pdf
Python SDK: https://github.com/Linkd-TaxID/kra-etims-sdk
Package: taxid-etims; import: kra_etims
